summary: Finds intersections or nearest points between faces, curves, and surfaces, then cuts, extracts, or keeps selected pieces from the left and right inputs.

key_params.name: xsect
key_params.note: Find intersections instead of closest points.

key_params.name: left
key_params.note: Keep mode for left input geometry.

key_params.name: right
key_params.note: Keep mode for right input geometry.

key_params.name: extractpt
key_params.note: Extract points at the intersection/closest location.

key_params.name: keeporiginal
key_params.note: Keep original primitives in addition to generated results.

common_gotchas: Minimum-distance mode has documented limitations for face/surface combinations when `xsect` is off.
Small tolerance changes can flip between no result, intersection, or closest-point extraction.
The left and right keep menus are separate, so asymmetric results are often intentional.
key_concepts: Curvesect SOP finds intersections or closest points between faces, curves, and surfaces.
`method` chooses whether to cut geometry or extract pieces around intersection results.
Left and right inputs have independent keep controls, and `affect` scopes extraction to left, right, or both sides.
`tolerance` materially changes whether near misses count as intersections or closest points.
